about_the_game:
PGA TOUR 2K25 Member’s Pass includes PGA TOUR 2K25 Clubhouse Pass Premium for Seasons 1-5 and the Clubhouse Gear Pack. Progress at your own pace—play through existing Clubhouse Pass Seasons even when a new Season is live!

PGA TOUR 2K25 Member's Pass is included in the PGA TOUR 2K25 Legend Edition. Also available for individual purchase. Member's Pass includes Seasons 1-5 of the Clubhouse Pass Premium which unlocks additional premium rewards through gameplay. Season 1 will be available at launch. Seasons 2-5 of the Clubhouse Pass Premium will be released post-launch. More details on the Clubhouse Pass Premium will be shared in the future.
